Qualcomm’s QSI segment EBT increase was also primarily driven by net gains on non-marketable equity investments, without specifying a single divestiture event like Intel's Astera Labs sale. Both disclosures highlight that investment portfolio performance significantly impacted their respective financial results for the year.
